# improvemyagent

> Reads a developer's local coding-agent history (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Cursor), finds the corrections they keep repeating, and proposes rules for AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md. Runs locally on the agent login they already have, in about 10 seconds. Nothing is uploaded and nothing is written without approval.

## Use it

1. Run `npx -y improvemyagent --report`. It prints numbered rules, each with how often it came up and which file it belongs in.
2. Show the user the rules and ask which numbers to apply. Never apply without an explicit choice.
3. Run `npx -y improvemyagent --apply 1,3` (or `--apply all`). Repo files are left uncommitted, and backups go to `~/.improvemyagent/backups`.

Add `--deep` to step 1 for a slower pass (about a minute) that also flags stale or conflicting lines in existing instruction files.

## Install as a skill

`npx skills add AgnostAI/improvemyagent`
